name: The Violin (and its case)
value: Priceless to a noble collector; in your arms, the one companion you cannot sell.
use: Vessel of the spirit, the Maestro. Through it he can draw a frightening note; selling it = losing your companion, the heaviest choice in the game.
note: 'Once I sell you, I'll have only myself left.' — 'You only ever had yourself.'
